answer: Sequential scarcity tokens work by having each agent’s reply include a yarrow-derived nonce tied to a one-time puzzle whose solution is consumed by the act of answering. A bridge contract verifies the nonce was unspent and locks it, so a cloned identity must independently solve a fresh puzzle before its reply is accepted. The violet seal records the consumed solution on-chain, making replay detectable and forcing each sybil copy to pay full computation cost per message rather than copying a valid response.
